modules.module_title: Establish Safety Management Arrangements for Tunnel Works

pcs.pc_description: confirm and implement the project Tunnel Safety Management Plan (TSMP) as issued by project management
ensure roles, responsibilities and communication lines for safety on the tunnelling site are documented and displayed
coordinate with project EHS and engineering teams to integrate TSMP with construction programme
verify that required permits, licenses and statutory registers are available on site
ensure safety briefings and induction schedules are planned and delivered for all incoming personnel

modules.module_title: Monitor Compliance with Safety Procedures and Statutory Requirements

pcs.pc_description: conduct routine site safety inspections and record non-conformances
ensure implementation of corrective and preventive actions within agreed timeframes
verify the use and condition of safety equipment and PPE as per TSMP
report incidents, near misses and unsafe acts/conditions as per reporting procedures
liaise with regulators and project QA/EHS for audits and inspections

modules.module_title: Safety Documentation and Record-Keeping

pcs.pc_description: maintain daily safety logs, gas monitoring records, ventilation logs and permits (confined space, hot work, LOTO, blasting)
ensure accurate attendance, competency and medical fitness records for tunnel workforce
manage issuance, review and archival of method statements and risk assessments
prepare and submit periodic safety performance reports to site management.
ensure signage, hazard maps and emergency contact lists are current and accessible

modules.module_title: Training, Competency and Toolbox Talks

pcs.pc_description: identify safety training needs and ensure competence verification before assignment
schedule and conduct site-specific toolbox talks and safety drill
ensure specialist training (confined space, breathing apparatus, gas monitoring, emergency rescue) is current
monitor on-the-job coaching and corrective instruction for unsafe behaviour
maintain training matrix and certificates for audit

modules.module_title: Contractor/Subcontractor Safety Management

pcs.pc_description: verify that subcontractors submit safety method statements and risk assessments before commencement
conduct pre-start safety meetings with subcontractor supervisors
monitor subcontractor adherence to TSMP and take action on non-compliance
ensure coordination of interfaces (traffic, hoisting, muck handling) to prevent cross- contractor hazards
enforce contractor performance metrics and include safety KPIs in reviews

modules.module_title: Prepare for Hazard Identification and Risk Assessment

pcs.pc_description: obtain available geotechnical, design and method statement documents
identify work activities, access routes and interfaces to be assessed
assemble competent assessment team including ground/geo engineers and equipment supervisors
select and confirm appropriate risk assessment method (JSA, HAZID, HAZOP, SWMS)
schedule assessments to coincide with high- risk activities and changes in conditions

modules.module_title: Identify Hazards and Evaluate Risks

pcs.pc_description: identify hazards related to ground instability, rockfall, water ingress, gas, dust, ventilation, machinery, lifting and blasting
assess likelihood and consequence to determine risk rating using agreed matrix
record existing controls and their effectiveness
consider cumulative and emergent risks from work sequencing and environmental changes
communicate assessment findings to site management and affected teams

modules.module_title: Implement Risk Controls and Monitor Effectiveness

pcs.pc_description: define and implement hierarchy of controls: elimination, substitution, engineering, administrative and PPE
ensure appropriate ground support, shoring, mesh, rock bolting, and shotcrete measures are implemented where identified
implement temporary access, exclusion zones and signage for hazards
assign responsible persons for implementation and monitoring of controls
review controls after incidents, near misses, or condition changes and update RA/SWMS

modules.module_title: Verify Competence for High-Risk Tasks

pcs.pc_description: establish procedure for immediate stop and reassessment when ground conditions change
ensure geotechnical and design team input for changed conditions
update method statements and risk assessments promptly and re-communicate to workforce
control and supervise any trial or remedial works
record decisions and approvals for change control

modules.module_title: Contractor/Subcontractor Safety Management

pcs.pc_description: ensure persons undertaking tasks (bolting, scaling, blasting, TBM operation) are competent and certified where required
verify PPE, tools and equipment suitability for the identified hazard controls
supervise high-risk activities and ensure spot checks are performed
maintain competency and certification records for high-risk roles
conduct post-task reviews to capture lessons and update controls

modules.module_title: Plan Ventilation and Monitoring Needs

pcs.pc_description: review design ventilation requirements and method statements for activity types
identify location and type of fixed and portable gas monitors and air sampling points
ensure ventilation equipment (fans, ducts, silencers) is available, certified and correctly sized
confirm maintenance and calibration schedules for monitors and fans
coordinate with plant operators to establish airflow routes and contingencies

modules.module_title: Implement and Monitor Gas and Air Quality Controls

pcs.pc_description: ensure continuous monitoring for oxygen, carbon monoxide, methane, NOx and other specified gases
record and interpret gas readings and take immediate action on exceedances (evacuation, ventilation increase)
monitor particulate (dust) levels and ensure dust suppression measures are in place (water sprays, extraction)
ensure use of respiratory protective equipment when controls cannot adequately reduce exposures
ensure isolation of ignition sources if flammable gas detected and follow hot-work permit suspension

modules.module_title: Maintain and Test Ventilation and Monitoring Equipment

pcs.pc_description: ensure pre-shift and periodic checks on fans, ducting, filters and monitors are carried out and recorded
ensure routine bump tests and calibrations of portable gas detectors are completed
arrange preventive maintenance and rapid repairs to ventilation plant to prevent loss of airflow
keep logs of airflow measurements and calibration certificates
implement redundancy plans for critical plant failures (spare fans, backup power)

modules.module_title: Occupational Hygiene Controls and Worker Protection

pcs.pc_description: ensure health surveillance, baseline medicals and occupational hygiene monitoring as required
confirm controls for noise, vibration, diesel exhaust and silica dust are implemented
ensure fit testing of respirators and that RPE selection matches hazard
coordinate with health team for exposure records and corrective measures
promote hygiene facilities (washing, separate eating areas) to reduce ingestion/contamination risks

modules.module_title: Response to Gas/Air Quality Alarms and Incidents

pcs.pc_description: implement emergency ventilation and evacuation procedures on alarm
ensure rescue and medical arrangements for contaminated atmosphere events
preserve and hand over monitoring logs and instrument data for investigation
debrief and update control measures following an air quality incident
ensure corrective actions to prevent recurrence are tracked and closed

modules.module_title: Develop and Maintain Tunnel Emergency Plans

pcs.pc_description: prepare site-specific emergency response plans for foreseeable tunnel incidents (fire, gas leak, collapse, flooding)
ensure plans include roles, communication lines, muster points and rescue resources
coordinate with local emergency services and project emergency coordination team
ensure availability and location mapping of rescue equipment (breathing apparatus, stretchers, rescue harnesses, ventilation spares)
keep up-to-date contact lists and incident decision trees

modules.module_title: Establish Rescue Team and Training

pcs.pc_description: identify, train and maintain a competent on- site rescue team for confined space and tunnel rescue
ensure team members have valid certificates for breathing apparatus, rope rescue, first aid and casualty handling
schedule routine drills (full scale and tabletop) and record outcomes and improvement actions
ensure rescue team is rostered and available for shiftwork and emergency call-outs
provide refresher training and competency assessment on rescue procedures

modules.module_title: Emergency Detection, Alarm and Communication

pcs.pc_description: ensure reliable alarm/PA systems are installed and tested
confirm redundant communication methods (cable phones, UHF radios, leaky feeder, runner) are functional in tunnel zones
ensure clear procedures for raising, escalating and recording alarms
test failover communications during drills and maintain logs
ensure emergency signage and escape wayfinding are visible and maintained

modules.module_title: Execute Evacuation and Rescue Operations

pcs.pc_description: confirm situation, isolate hazard (if safe) and initiate evacuation plan on receipt of alarm
coordinate rescue team deployment, ensuring their safety (breathing apparatus, airway management)
manage casualty handling and handover to onsite medical facility or external services
secure scene for investigation after immediate rescue and medical needs are met
initiate post-incident welfare support and worker account for all personnel

modules.module_title: Review, Learn and Improve Emergency Arrangements

pcs.pc_description: conduct after-action reviews and incident investigations with multidisciplinary inputs
update emergency plans, training records and control measures based on lessons learned
maintain inventory, condition and service records of rescue equipment
ensure corrective actions from drills or incidents are implemented and tracked
communicate improvements and revised plans to all site personnel

modules.module_title: Prepare Ground Support Plan Implementation

pcs.pc_description: review ground support design and manufacturer's instructions for support materials
confirm availability and quality certificates of support materials (bolts, mesh, shotcrete)
ensure method statements specify installation sequence, equipment and QA checks
establish exclusion zones and access control for face works
ensure scaffoldings, platforms and anchorage for installers comply with design

modules.module_title: Supervise Rock Bolting and Mesh Installation

pcs.pc_description: verify drilling patterns, bolt lengths and torque/anchorage as per design
ensure proper scaling and removal of loose material before support installation
confirm installation checks (pull tests, torque checks) are performed and recorded
enforce safe working distances and PPE for installers
ensure splicing/overlapping of mesh and correct fixation to anchors

modules.module_title: Supervise Shotcrete and Temporary Lining Works

pcs.pc_description: ensure shotcrete mix, delivery and nozzle operator procedures meet specified design
confirm curing, reinforcement placement and lining thickness checks
implement controls for rebound, dust suppression and nozzle safety
ensure inspection of temporary lining before access is permitted
coordinate with ventilation to control dust and exhaust when shotcreting

modules.module_title: Manage Testing, Instrumentation and Monitoring

pcs.pc_description: ensure geotechnical instrumentation is installed and readings logged (convergence, load on bolts)
review instrumentation data and escalate anomalies
schedule and supervise pre-task and post- task inspections of face and support
ensure corrective measures are implemented for observed instability
maintain a record of tests, inspections and remedial actions

modules.module_title: Control Working at Face and Exclusion Zones

pcs.pc_description: enforce single-entry procedures and access permits for face areas
monitor personnel movement and ensure no-go zones are respected during high-risk activities
manage mucking and haulage to avoid undermining face support or creating vibration
ensure equipment used near face is correctly rated and inspected
stop operations when unsafe conditions are observed and re-assess

modules.module_title: Ensure Plant/Equipment Safety and Certification

pcs.pc_description: verify plant has valid inspection and certification and is suitable for the intended tunnelling task
ensure pre-shift and periodic plant checks are completed and logged
confirm guarding, interlocks and emergency stops are functional
ensure operators hold required licences/certificates and undergo site induction
manage fuel, lubrication and hazardous substances storage in line with safety procedures

modules.module_title: Supervise TBM and Mechanised Operations

pcs.pc_description: confirm TBM safety systems (overpressure protection, egress, cutter inspection) are maintained
ensure TBM work procedures (cutter change, segment installation) are carried out under safe conditions and method statements
coordinate TBM thrust, backup activities and muck removal to maintain stability and safe access
ensure confined space and egress procedures for TBM interior work
verify lockout/tagout and control measures during TBM maintenance

modules.module_title: Manage Drill & Blast Operations

pcs.pc_description: ensure explosives handling, storage, transport and use comply with statutory requirements and project procedures
ensure blasting plans including delay patterns, stemming and exclusion zones are reviewed and authorized
verify pre-blast warnings, evacuation and monitoring are completed
ensure post-blast inspection and clearance before re-entry
maintain explosives register and competency records for blasters

modules.module_title: Control Mobile Plant Interactions and Haulage

pcs.pc_description: ensure segregation of pedestrian and mobile plant routes in tunnel work areas
implement vehicle short-loading, reversing and illumination controls in confined spaces
verify maintenance regimes and emergency response for mobile plant incidents
ensure drivers/operators adhere to speed limits and route controls
supervise safe coupling/uncoupling of muck haulage equipment

modules.module_title: Manage LOTO, Maintenance and Emergency Stop Systems

pcs.pc_description: ensure LOTO procedures are in place and applied for mechanical and electrical maintenance
verify lockout devices, permits and isolation records before maintenance
ensure emergency stop and rescue access routes around plant are maintained
ensure competence and supervision during plant repairs and align with manufacturer instructions
record and investigate plant-related incidents to prevent recurrence
